summary: Linn County lookout on a rock pillar: 8x8 frame cab in 1927, L-4 cab in 1935, abandoned 1963. Forest Service still lists the trail to the rock.

facts.design: 8x8 ft frame cab (1927) reached by about 100 ft of ladder up the pillar; L-4 cab added 1935
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1963 and gone by 1966 per the Register; SummitPost says nothing really remains of the lookout at the summit

access.note: Forest Service trail runs to the rock in the Menagerie Wilderness; the agency asks visitors to check current conditions with the local ranger station

events.note: 8x8 ft frame cab near the top of the rock, reached by about 100 ft of ladder
Newspaper item: two Albany men had just returned from building a lookout station on the rock
L-4 cab (14x14 ground house) built behind and above the original location
June 1938 report: the Forest Service had already posted a lookout on the rock
William D. Morgan named as lookout fireman for the summer
CCC crew built a three-mile trail from Trout Creek camp to the lookout
Register-Guard item: a high school boy would spend the summer manning the station
Abandoned, per Oregon Lookouts and the Forest Service
Register says the lookout was gone by 1966

corrections.proposed: 8x8 ft frame cab (1927); L-4 cab added 1935
corrections.why: The L-4 was the 1935 cab. The original 1927 lookout was an 8x8 frame cab reached by ladder, per the Register and Oregon Lookouts.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Oregon Lookouts and the Forest Service date abandonment to 1963; the Register says gone by 1966. FireLookout.com's R.I.P. 1927-1935 heading would imply an end in 1935, which the other sources do not support. The story gives 1963 as the abandonment year and notes the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Abandonment date conflicts (1963 vs gone by 1966 vs FireLookout.com heading 1927-1935); story gives 1963. The AllTrails and Roadtrippers search snippets claim 'wooden remains' of the lookout, but AllTrails returned HTTP 403 and neither page was read, so the story does not use that claim. Brief coordinates conflict (FFLOS 44.41779,-122.30387 vs West US Lookouts 44.40416,-122.29739); not resolved. Brief's design L-4 is corrected to note the 1927 frame cab. No photos added.
